name_or_annotation_only_hits.finding: FGFR1-4 occur as genome-scale gene products, metabolite/reaction annotations, or non-FGFR model annotations. No receptor states, FGFR signaling reactions, or usable FGFR kinetic laws were present.

isoform_specific_representations.FGFR1: only qualitative/topology or annotation representations; no explicit quantitative receptor model
isoform_specific_representations.FGFR2: annotation-only representation; no useful receptor/signaling model
isoform_specific_representations.FGFR3: qualitative/topology-only representation; no explicit quantitative receptor model
isoform_specific_representations.conclusion: No. The local corpus does not justify separate FGFR1, FGFR2, and FGFR3 kinetic representations from local BioModels alone. Generic FGFR kinetics must not be relabeled as isoform-specific.
